text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote states Almamlaka TV is launching the DEI to modernize its digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote states the primary goal is a 40% digital viewership increase within the first year of launch."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote lists the three secondary goals exactly as claimed."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote names three platforms: mobile app (iOS/Android), web streaming portal, third-party smart TV integration."},{"claim_index":4,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote says a steering committee with reps from Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Legal & Compliance oversees the project."},{"claim_index":5,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Quote lists MAU, average session duration, app store ratings, and content engagement rates as success measures."},{"claim_index":6,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Evidence states Project Lead: Sara Al-Rashid and Project Duration: 14 months."},{"claim_index":7,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Overview document lists Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000."},{"claim_index":8,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Budget document states the budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 after the Finance Committee's December 2026 revision and that other figures reflect the originally approved budget."},{"claim_index":9,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Overview document lists Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027."},{"claim_index":10,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The Governance document states the public launch moved to April 1, 2027 to allow more smart TV integration testing time."},{"claim_index":11,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Neutral label asserting no fact."},{"claim_index":12,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"Neutral label asserting no fact."}]}
